Rules:
- Translate the block as a coherent passage, not as isolated source lines.
- Do not manually insert @h or speaker names. The tool will wrap lines and create game windows automatically.
- Preserve character voice, narrative flow, and important pauses.
- ASCII apostrophes and contractions are allowed. Do not use curly quotes, em dashes, en dashes, or ellipsis characters.
- The English may be longer or shorter than the Japanese if that improves quality.

prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

prompt_parts.label: Previous Scene Translations
prompt_parts.content:
Previous translated blocks in this scene:
{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0004",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 5,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01053-01055",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "ハイシェラに答えるつもりだったが、うっかりと\n声に出して呟いた俺に、換えのシーツを手にしたリンシャが\n戸口から微笑んでいた。",
      "en": "I had meant to answer Haishera, but I inadvertently spoke aloud. Rinsha, holding fresh sheets, smiled at me from the doorway."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01057-01059",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "さぁ、荷物を置いたらシュリちゃんを誘って\n下の食堂に行って、お腹空いてるでしょ？",
      "en": "Come on, put your things down and bring Shuri\nto the dining room downstairs. You're hungry, right?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01061-01062",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "言われるまで気にしていなかったが、そう言えば\nこの街に着いてからまだ何も口にしていない。",
      "en": "I hadn't noticed until she mentioned it, but come to think of it, I haven't eaten anything since arriving in this town."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01064-01065",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "いいのか？",
      "en": "Is that all right?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01067-01068",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "大丈夫、ちゃんと付けにしておくから",
      "en": "It's fine, I'll put it on your tab."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01070-01070",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "そう言ってリンシャは胸元から先程の宝石を取り出して見せた。",
      "en": "So saying, she took the gem from her bosom."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01076-01085",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺とリンシャは二階にある部屋から連れ立って階段を\n降りて来た。\nあの後、誘うまでもなく俺の部屋に様子を見に来たシュリが\nリンシャの手にしたシーツを見ると、\n部屋の掃除やベッドメイクは自分がやると申し出た。\n最初は悪いと言って遠慮したリンシャだったが、\nシュリの懇願する様な態度に圧倒され、\nその申し出を承諾したのだ。",
      "en": "Rinsha and I came down the stairs from the second floor. After that, Shuri checked on my room uninvited. She saw the sheets Rinsha was holding and offered to clean the room and make the bed herself. Rinsha initially declined, saying it was too much, but Shuri's pleading look convinced her to agree."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01087-01088",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "変わった子ね……",
      "en": "She's a strange one, isn't she..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01090-01092",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "シュリがリンシャからシーツを受け取った時に浮かべた\n喜々とした笑顔を思い出しているのだろう、\nリンシャが複雑な笑顔で俺に話しかける。",
      "en": "She must be remembering the delighted smile Shuri wore when she took the sheets. Rinsha speaks to me with a complicated smile."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01094-01095",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "あの娘は、家で一番の働き者だからな",
      "en": "She's the hardest worker in our home, you know."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01097-01098",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "あら、他にも使用人が居るの？",
      "en": "Oh, you have other servants too?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01100-01101",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "ああ",
      "en": "Yeah."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01103-01105",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ふーん、そんなに使用人を抱えているなんて、\nセリカってもしかして貴族？",
      "en": "Hmm, you keep that many servants? Celica, are you a noble?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01107-01108",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "いや",
      "en": "No."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01110-01111",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "じゃあ、何者なの？",
      "en": "Then, what are you?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01113-01118",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "何者、との問いに応えず、俺は昼時を過ぎて空き始めた\n食堂の手近なテーブルに着いた。\n俺の沈黙を言いたくないのだろうと判断したのか、\nリンシャは何も言わずにカウンターからメニューを\n持ってきて俺の前に置いた。",
      "en": "Without answering her, I sat at a nearby table in the dining room, which had started to empty after lunch. Guessing my silence meant I didn't want to say, Rinsha said nothing and brought a menu from the counter, placing it in front of me."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01120-01121",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "味は保証するわよ",
      "en": "I guarantee it tastes great!"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01123-01126",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "満面に笑みを湛えたリンシャが、\nその豊かな胸をさらに張って見せる。\n確かに、この食堂内を包む料理の香りは\n俺の食指を刺激するのに十分だ。",
      "en": "Rinsha's face lit up with a smile as she puffed\nout her ample chest even more.\nThe aroma of cooking that filled the dining room\nwas certainly enough to whet my appetite."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01128-01130",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "そうだな……\nそれほどしつこくなくて、あまり量が無い物……",
      "en": "Right...\nSomething not too heavy, and not much of it."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01132-01133",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "女の子みたいな物を頼むわね……それだったらこれよ",
      "en": "You order like a girl... Then, this one."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01135-01135",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "リンシャの指がメニューに書かれた一つの料理を指す。",
      "en": "Rinsha's finger pointed to a dish on the menu."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01137-01138",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "そうか",
      "en": "I see"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01140-01141",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "それで、シュリちゃんは……",
      "en": "So what about Shuri...?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:01143-01144",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "すぐ来る",
      "en": "She'll be right down."
    }
  ]
}
